subject.title: message tool should auto-select the only enabled account

question: Should omitted outbound message account selection change from documented default-account fallback to enabled-account inference when exactly one account is enabled and configured?
rationale: The fix improves multi-account delivery DX, but it intentionally changes fallback behavior in a compatibility-sensitive channel/account path that current docs describe differently.

options.title: Adopt shared enabled-account inference
options.body: Use the shared resolver approach from the linked candidate PR after rebase, proof, and docs/tests, while preserving explicit/default/bound account precedence.

options.title: Preserve current fallback contract
options.body: Keep defaultAccount/default/first-account fallback behavior and require explicit accountId or defaultAccount configuration for multi-account proactive sends.

options.title: Narrow the policy first
options.body: Only infer for a constrained case, such as disabled default plus exactly one enabled configured account, or only for selected channel plugins with proven safe semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared enabled-account inference
recommendation.body: Use the shared resolver approach from the linked candidate PR after rebase, proof, and docs/tests, while preserving explicit/default/bound account precedence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the issue-level follow-up direction and has adjacent default-account docs/helper history, making this the strongest product-policy routing candidate.
